sub_agent_reviews.summary: The single Scout agent was launched for llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety together, but timed out and was closed without a usable candidate table.

Manual fallback kept the same merged three-track contract. Candidates included DeepMind AI Control Roadmap, OpenAI Deployment Simulation, arXiv agent/tool-use papers, post-training RL papers, and AI safety framework items; DeepMind was rejected as duplicate and OpenAI Deployment Simulation was selected.
